items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) exited early and ruled out vs Rams; watching with Tank Bigsby. Berry noted early exit.
Lamar Jackson day-to-day ankle injury; left stadium in protective boot, Q to return in-game then monitored this week. ETR watching.
items.why: In-game exit; Rap day-to-day + Schefter boot
items.implication: High risk next week; backup contingency

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled out with concussion after facemask/hit in first half vs Jaguars; walked off but did not return.
items.implication: Immediate sit; protocol likely multi-week risk

items.text: Bigger dock on Ladd McConkey (foot/ribs) despite expected/active; LP-DNP-LP practice, already cracked rib history. Schefter confirmed active; later foot aggravation noted in watch list.
items.why: Schefter active confirmation; ETR bigger dock for multi-injury
items.implication: Playable but capped ceiling; monitor post-game aggravation
items.conflict: Some reports later listed out; usage may lag status

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin/hip) after return; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Upgrade from prior snap-count speculation.
items.why: Schefter confirmation of no snap limit; ETR small dock only
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected vs Eagles; strong start/sit and ROS

items.text: Terry McLaurin not expected to play (hamstring); confirmed inactive/out context.
items.why: ETR not expected; aligns Schefter/Rap inactive reports
items.implication: Sit; look to Commanders other WRs or deebo-samuel if available

items.text: Tee Higgins (adductor) on post-game injury watch list alongside Chase concussion; potential Bengals WR depletion beneficiary if Chase protocol extends.
items.implication: If healthy, massive target bump with Chase out

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with snap management (ankle maintenance/freshness); limited 2nd half in close game despite no new injury. Coaches managing workload.
items.why: Player comments on management for long season; not 100%
items.opportunity: Goal-line still possible but reduced overall
items.conflict: High draft capital vs current role

items.text: DJ Moore aggravated shoulder injury vs Patriots; not considered long-term issue currently. ETR/Berry early exit watch.
Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful (hamstring) mid-game; did not return. ETR watching; Chiefs interest in Tyreek Hill noted post.
items.implication: Likely out or limited next; WR depth crunch with Thornton too

items.text: Eagles potentially without four key: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring OUT), TE Dallas Goedert (knee OUT), LB Zack Baun (concussion). Depleted offense vs Rams.
items.why: Schefter Johnson Q + prior outs; Levitan summary
items.implication: Suppressed Eagles pass game/volume; A.J. Brown or others elevated if active

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected to have hard pitch count per Fowler. Expected to play.
items.why: Beat report no hard pitch count; ETR tinier dock
items.implication: Near-normal snap/route share for Ravens WR

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/optimistic (ribs) with bigger dock; later officially active per Rapoport after late practice.
items.why: ETR optimistic GTD; Rap confirmed active
items.opportunity: Red-zone if limited snaps still high leverage

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who is starting and crushing.
items.why: Role solidification and production vs draft capital/perception
items.implication: Hold/start ROS; trade-up target if available
